subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and maintain the experimental grouped-Claw manifest and read-only planning contract as a core CLI surface before the dependent lifecycle slices land?
rationale: The patch is an intentional new core product/API direction, not a repair of established behavior; its JSON schema, CLI commands, environment gate, and downstream lifecycle dependency create a compatibility commitment that only maintainers can accept or decline.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded experimental core contract
options.body: Approve this read-only schema/planner as the supported experimental base, assign a long-term owner, and require later slices to preserve its declared compatibility boundary.

options.title: Keep the work at RFC scope for now
options.body: Do not merge the base CLI/schema until maintainers decide the ownership model and durable installation identity, leaving the dependent stack unlanded.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded experimental core contract
recommendation.body: Approve this read-only schema/planner as the supported experimental base, assign a long-term owner, and require later slices to preserve its declared compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review establishes the concrete core invariants and remaining lifecycle-contract questions for this surface.
